name: Condado Time Adherence - Weekly Summary
query:
SELECT
  x.wk AS "Week Of:Date:100",
  IF(MAX(x.closed) = 1, 'Closed', 'Open') AS "Week::70",
  MAX(x.eff_days) AS "Days Due:Int:80",
  COUNT(*) AS "People:Int:70",
  SUM(x.on_track) AS "On Track:Int:80",
  SUM(x.eff_days > 0 AND x.on_track = 0) AS "Off Track:Int:80",
  IF(MAX(x.eff_days) = 0, NULL, ROUND(100 * SUM(x.on_track) / COUNT(*), 0)) AS "Adherence Pct:Percent:110",
  SUM(x.eff_days > 0 AND x.hrs = 0) AS "No Time Logged:Int:120",
  SUM(x.noproj > 0) AS "Logged No Project:Int:130",
  SUM(x.hrs < 8*x.eff_days) AS "Under Hours:Int:100",
  SUM(x.eff_days - x.days_logged > 0) AS "Missed Days:Int:100",
  SUM(x.closed = 1 AND x.unsub > 0) AS "Not Submitted:Int:110",
  SUM(x.eff_days > 0 AND x.bill < 0.8*GREATEST(8*x.eff_days - x.pto, 0)) AS "Under Billable:Int:110",
  ROUND(SUM(x.hrs), 1) AS "Hours:Float:80",
  ROUND(SUM(8*x.eff_days), 1) AS "Hours Target:Float:100",
  ROUND(SUM(x.bill), 1) AS "Billable Hours:Float:110",
  ROUND(SUM(0.8*GREATEST(8*x.eff_days - x.pto, 0)), 1) AS "Billable Target:Float:110",
  ROUND(SUM(x.unsub), 1) AS "Hours Not Submitted:Float:140",
  ROUND(SUM(x.pending), 1) AS "Hours Awaiting Approval:Float:160",
  ROUND(SUM(x.noproj), 1) AS "Hours No Project:Float:130"
FROM (
  SELECT y.*,
    CASE WHEN y.eff_days > 0 AND y.hrs >= 8*y.eff_days AND y.eff_days - y.days_logged <= 0 AND (y.closed = 0 OR y.unsub = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_track
  FROM (
    SELECT e.name AS employee, w.wk,
      IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), w.wk) >= 7, 1, 0) AS closed,
      GREATEST(GREATEST(0, LEAST(LEAST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), w.wk), 7) - 1, 5)) - IFNULL(h.hol_days,0), 0) AS eff_days,
      IFNULL(l.total_hrs,0) AS hrs,
      IFNULL(l.bill_hrs,0) AS bill,
      IFNULL(l.pto_hrs,0) AS pto,
      IFNULL(l.days_logged,0) AS days_logged,
      IFNULL(l.unsub_hrs,0) AS unsub,
      IFNULL(l.pending_hrs,0) AS pending,
      IFNULL(l.noproj_hrs,0) AS noproj
    FROM `tabEmployee` e
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT w0.wk FROM (
        SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY), INTERVAL 7*nn.n DAY) AS wk
        FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7) nn
      ) w0 WHERE w0.wk >= '2026-11-01'
    ) w
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT hl.parent AS holiday_list,
        DATE_SUB(hl.holiday_date, INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(hl.holiday_date)-1 DAY) AS wk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hl.holiday_date) AS hol_days
      FROM `tabHoliday` hl
      WHERE IFNULL(hl.weekly_off,0) = 0
        AND DAYOFWEEK(hl.holiday_date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
        AND hl.holiday_date >= '2026-11-01'
        AND hl.holiday_date < CURDATE()
      GROUP BY hl.parent, wk
    ) h ON h.holiday_list = e.holiday_list AND h.wk = w.wk
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT t.employee,
        DATE_SUB(DATE(td.from_time), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(td.from_time)-1 DAY) AS wk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(td.from_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN DATE(td.from_time) END) AS days_logged,
        SUM(td.hours) AS total_hrs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN td.is_billable = 1 THEN td.hours ELSE 0 END) AS bill_hrs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN td.project = '[Internal] - PTO' THEN td.hours ELSE 0 END) AS pto_hrs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.docstatus = 0 AND IFNULL(t.workflow_state,'Draft') NOT IN ('Pending Approval','Approved','Approved By PM') THEN td.hours ELSE 0 END) AS unsub_hrs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.docstatus = 0 AND t.workflow_state = 'Pending Approval' THEN td.hours ELSE 0 END) AS pending_hrs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(td.project,'') = '' THEN td.hours ELSE 0 END) AS noproj_hrs
      FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
      JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
      WHERE t.docstatus < 2
        AND td.from_time >= '2026-11-01'
        AND td.from_time < CURDATE()
      GROUP BY t.employee, wk
    ) l ON l.employee = e.name AND l.wk = w.wk
    WHERE e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.'
      AND e.status = 'Active'
      AND IFNULL(e.user_id,'') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
  ) y
) x
GROUP BY x.wk
ORDER BY x.wk ASC
